scientific_integrity: Exact finite rational counterexample to the stated 2012 theorem in the same iid-with-replacement expected-richness/coverage definitions. Correctness is supported by a proof for all m>1 and executable exact fraction checks; no independent audit, author attribution, or empirical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: At least one equal-coverage crossing is proved, not the number or location of all crossings. No conclusion on unknown probabilities, estimators, confidence intervals, non-iid sampling, finite reference samples, or universality of this phenomenon.
title: A three-species counterexample to size–coverage crossing equivalence in richness rarefaction
